[EN] See You in the Fall
[ES] Nos vemos en la caída
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You'll have to find a way down.
[ES] Tendrás que encontrar una forma de bajar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You're a sight for sore eyes!
[ES] ¡Qué bueno verte!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You're sure about this?"
[ES] "¿Estás seguro de esto?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Check in at the room with a caved-in floor in the southwest part of the sixth floor.
[ES] Regístra la habitación con el suelo derrumbado en la parte suroeste del sexto piso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Tysur in the Shrieking Catacombs. [Go through the caved-in floor or to Panpantun at the Gloomhaunt Sentry Post in order to access the Shrieking Catacombs.]
[ES] Habla con Tysur en las Shrieking Catacombs. [Pasa por el suelo derrumbado o habla con Panpantun en el Puesto de Centinela de Gloomhaunt para acceder a las Shrieking Catacombs.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
